dct_description_sm: This is an aerial photograph from the NJ Department of Environmental Protection Aerial Photographs Collection showing Milford, a borough located in Pike County, Pennsylvania, west of Sussex County, New Jersey.
This image was previously, erroneously, identified as Milford, New Jersey Aerial Photograph.
